name: Vizionfocus Inc.
summary: Vizionfocus Inc. engages in the manufacturing of medical equipment in Japan, China, Southeast Asia and the United States. It also manufactures mechanical equipment, optical instruments, and precision instruments; trades internationally; and provides other consulting services. In addition, the company engages in the research and development, design, OEM, development, and sale of contact lenses, as well as customized services. Vizionfocus Inc. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Miaoli, Taiwan.
